context_requirements: Expression of SYK or SYK-dependent signaling components (e.g., BCR-like or Fc receptor signaling)
Hematopoietic or B-cell lineage for strong canonical SYK dependence
Adhesion/integrin signaling context for SYK-dependent focal adhesion effects
Absence of compensatory kinase signaling (e.g., ZAP-70, JAK) that bypasses SYK
falsifiers: No change in any landmark gene at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Strong, consistent upregulation of proliferation markers (e.g., MYC, CCND1, MKI67) at 24 h
Selective and strong induction of interferon-stimulated genes across lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes identical to those of unrelated kinase inhibitors at 10 micromolar

evidence.supports: SYK inhibition blocks BCR signaling and reduces viability in B-cell malignancies
SYK inhibitor TAK-659 suppresses microenvironment-induced SYK signaling in CLL
SYK inhibitor R406 induces apoptosis in senescent fibroblasts via FAK/p38
SYK inhibitor PRT062607 suppresses osteoclastogenesis and breast cancer cell growth via PLCγ2/PI3K-AKT-mTOR
SYK inhibitor fostamatinib reduces inflammatory signaling and extracellular traps in lupus models
